body: Complex reforms fail when ministries, development institutions, researchers, investors and implementers are solving different versions of the same problem. IP3 designs evidence-led dialogue and decision processes that bring those perspectives together around practical pathways to action.

items.title: Policy dialogue
items.text: Structured conversations that move from diagnosis to decision, around a shared evidence base.

items.title: Executive roundtables
items.text: High-level gatherings for strategic alignment, designed to produce concrete commitments.

items.title: Investment forums
items.text: Curated events connecting capital to investment-ready pipelines.

items.title: Technical working groups
items.text: Deep-dive sessions that produce technical outputs for policy and implementation.

items.title: Research–policy translation
items.text: Processes that convert research findings into actionable policy options.

items.title: Stakeholder consultations
items.text: Inclusive processes for legitimacy and uptake.

items.title: Consensus-building processes
items.text: Facilitating agreement across diverse interests and ministries.
